title: Explainable Federated Learning via Global-Local Attribution Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.20445v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning enables on-device training without centralizing data, yet existing systems still struggle to provide explanations that are both locally faithful and globally consistent under strict privacy and bandwidth constraints. Prior approaches either keep explanations siloed across clients, transmit heavy or sensitive artifacts, or replace expressive task models with interpretable surrogates that sacrifice accuracy. We propose xFedAlign, a model-agnostic framework that decouples task optimization in parameter space from explanation coordination in a compact group space. Each client distills a lightweight surrogate to produce private, per-class top-k attribution artifacts, which are robustly aggregated by the server into a Global Explanation Prior that softly aligns client explanations without constraining task learning. translated_title: 通过全局-局部归因对齐实现可解释联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使得无需集中数据即可在设备端进行训练，然而现有系统在严格的隐私和带宽约束下，仍难以提供既在局部忠实又在全局一致的解释。先前的方法要么将解释孤立地保存在各个客户端中，要么传输庞大或敏感的产物，要么用可解释的替代模型替换富有表现力的任务模型从而牺牲准确性。我们提出了xFedAlign，这是一个模型无关的框架，它将参数空间中的任务优化与紧凑群组空间中的解释协调解耦。每个客户端蒸馏出一个轻量级替代模型，以生成私有的、按类别的top-k归因产物，服务器将这些产物稳健地聚合为一个全局解释先验，该先验可软性地对齐客户端解释而不约束任务学习。在具有IID和非IID划分的图像、文本和表格基准测试中，xFedAlign达到了与FedAvg相当的准确率……
tldr: 提出xFedAlign框架，通过将参数空间的任务优化与紧凑群组空间的解释协调解耦，利用轻量级归因产物聚合出全局解释先验来软性对齐客户端解释，在严格隐私和带宽约束下实现联邦学习中局部忠实且全局一致的可解释性，同时保持与FedAvg相当的准确性。
en_tdlr: xFedAlign is a model-agnostic framework that decouples task optimization in parameter space from explanation coordination via a globally aggregated explanation prior, achieving locally faithful and globally consistent explanations in federated learning under strict privacy and bandwidth constraints while matching FedAvg accuracy.
